## Checklist
- [ ] `make verify` passes locally
- [ ] Tests written first or with the change (a bypass fix adds a case to `tests/redteam/regressions.yaml`)
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/limitations.md` if a limitation changed)
- [ ] No new dependency (or an ADR justifies it)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
